items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I loved Isham Jones' band, too. He had a good band.

ctx.x: No, I didn't. We didn't. And -- oh, no, we never did. I mean, if it was good, we listened to it and we copied off the records, you know what I mean? Because we
copied off Coon-Saunders and Ted Weems and there was another band. I'm trying to think -- oh, Isham Jones. I loved Isham Jones' band, too. He had a good band.
Were you aware of a Morton and King Oliver?
